explanation: Compose the verified stored-data, catalog, frontier, and terminal contracts in their actual execution order, retaining the protected regions and summing the prescribed finite costs. This search contract joins positive-frontier traversal to exact physical terminal tests for one compatible wanted key.

theorem_natural_language_statement:
Fix a compatible original-index wanted key and stopping depth $K\le J$. Suppose all source and catalog stages, their records, the initial frontier and capacity, physical source buckets, occurrence indices, cover tables, and original value arrays satisfy their exact stored predicates. Assume all protected ranges, child and terminal workspaces, word-safe original values and target sums, pair-count capacity, and the full depth bound including the actual terminal-frontier length. Procedure 94 returns a Boolean precisely when some retained level-$K$ prefix satisfies the terminal physical hit predicate; it meets the exact search-time bound and preserves memory below the root frontier.

This search contract joins positive-frontier traversal to exact physical terminal tests for one compatible wanted key.
